do_not: invent table columns not in the plan

implements: type-level spine for all contracts above
consumes: for routes that augment rows with resolved data, define a <Row>WithLive shape
produces: exported types every route + UI file imports — no cross-file structural typing

accept caller-supplied ids without validating shape

consumes: GET /admin/waitlist requestShape: cursor, item_external_id, item_scope, status_filter
PUT /admin/settings requestShape: quiet_hours_end, quiet_hours_start, template_body, template_subject
produces: GET /admin/stats responseShape: conversion_rate, next_cursor, total_converted, total_count, total_notified, total_signups

call a bound op only to discard its returned id
provision Shopify side-effects outside DB transaction without rollback path

implements: inventory level for a variant rises above zero
a product is deleted from the store
a customer completes a paid order

produces: idempotent DB writes per the capability each trigger drives
ON CONFLICT on every dedup-keyed insert
do_not: early-return when a declared signalField is empty
